PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: Clement's clue ("He was exactly one row south of someone sitting in a chair.") needs the person sitting in a chair one row north of Clement on a square that does not share his row or column; that rules out squares for Clement.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: The murderer must be in Valentine's area without sharing his row or column; that rules out squares for Valentine.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: Basil and Emil can only use columns 4 and 5 between them, so nobody else can be in those columns.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: The same kind of reasoning rules out a few more squares. Flora's own clue ("She was in the Beach or the Fish Market. She was south of Helena.") rules out more squares. All of Alma's squares are in column 3, so nobody else can use it. So Flora (F) must be at row 4, column 1. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: Basil is now the only person who can still go in row 1. So Basil (B) must be at row 1, column 5. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_6_en: With the rows and columns of Flora and Basil crossed out, only one square is left for Emil that fits his clue ("He was beside a table. He was beside the safe."). So Emil (E) must be at row 2, column 4. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_7_en: Only one square of column 2 is still open to anyone (row 6, column 2). Someone must stand there, so nobody else can use row 6. So Alma (A) must be at row 5, column 3. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_8_en: The murderer must be in Valentine's area without sharing his row or column; that rules out squares for Valentine. All of Grace's squares are in row 7, so nobody else can use it. Dexter is now the only person who can still go in row 6. So Dexter (D) must be at row 6, column 2. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_9_en: Who can be the person sitting in a chair one row north of Clement? Only Grace, because nobody else can still reach a square that fits Clement's clue ("He was exactly one row south of someone sitting in a chair."). That rules out Grace's other squares. So Grace (G) must be at row 7, column 9. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_10_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Helena that fits her clue ("She was in the Beach or the Harbour Office. She was exactly one column east of Clement."). So Helena (H) must be at row 3, column 8. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_11_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Clement that fits his clue ("He was exactly one row south of someone sitting in a chair."). So Clement (C) must be at row 8, column 7. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_12_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Valentine. So Valentine (the victim) must be at row 9, column 6. Cross out his row and column. Clement is the only person in the Tavern with Valentine, so Clement is the murderer!
